learning_outcomes.text: The discipline "Numerical methods" aims to familiarize students with the features of the basic principles of numerical methods; the practical interpretation of the formulas from the methods presented with the help of a calculation system and the realization of some calculation programs with applications in engineering, written in the Matlab programming language.
Knowledge and adequate use of notions specific to numerical calculation.
Understanding the content and essence of laboratory work.
Application of numerical methods in engineering problems.
Using the Matlab programming language for numerical calculation in engineering.
Choosing the numerical method appropriate to each type of problem.
Solving with the help of a calculation system the more complex engineering problems, for which the analytical solutions do not exist, or are unsatisfactory.
Acquiring the ability to use what they have learned in this discipline in the case of a rigorous and abstract approach to practical problems that may arise in further research (master's, doctorate).

Using the Matlab graphics environment. Building 2D and 3D graphics.
Programs for solving algebraic linear systems equations. Exact methods.

teaching_methods: Free presentation with exemplification on the board

assessment_methods.method: Exam (Oral examination, practical computer applications / Online Assessment (Online questionnaire))
Realization of all seminar applications (Continuous testing of the theory throughout the semester)
Realization of all laboratory applications (Practical application)

assessment_rules: The minimum performance standard is completion of all activities. The final mark is composed of 70% from the course exam, 15% from seminar activities, and 15% from laboratory activities.
